name: Naho
source:
The eccentric new member of the Misfits, a genius girl with incomparable speed in both mind and body.
Having stalked their leader for years already, her acceptance into the elite circle kickstarted a new chapter in Naho's life. 
She sports a habit of openly flirting with Hagi, much to his sister Varlim's chagrin.

The eccentric new member of the Misfits, a genius girl with incomparable speed in both mind and body.
